integrity: All abstract counting and probability claims are supported by explicit combinatorial and analytic proofs; a standard-library program provides finite corroboration, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Assumes labeled voters, precisely one delegate per voter and positive-length reachability. Covers distinct approval matrices, not committee outcomes or multi-delegation. This is a model-based uniform-profile sampling calculation rather than a behavioral prediction. Historical priority under alternate combinatorial names is not completely excluded.
title: Exact enumeration and shifted-Poisson component law for liquid approval profiles
